import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import subprocess

BASE = "f36e59a5e2cebab6fdfd0365920ca3e1a09444ac"
PROD = "9b3458b7674140569b550fb7f6034fe0eb9a83f3"
EVIDENCE = Path("docs/security/evidence/a37-1-c2")
REPORT = EVIDENCE / "validation.json"
CHECKSUMS = EVIDENCE / "SHA256SUMS"
PLAN = "docs/security/QBIND_AUDIT_REMEDIATION_PLAN.md"
FIXTURE = "scripts/devnet/tests/run_216_227_regression_verdict_fixture.sh"
PATHS = [
    "scripts/devnet/run_216_governance_execution_policy_release_binary.sh",
    "scripts/devnet/run_227_governance_evaluator_runtime_callsite_wiring_release_binary.sh",
    "docs/devnet/run_216_governance_execution_policy_release_binary/README.md",
    "docs/devnet/run_227_governance_evaluator_runtime_callsite_wiring_release_binary/README.md",
    PLAN, FIXTURE,
]
COMMANDS = []


def command(args, data=None, expected=0):
    p = subprocess.run(args, input=data, capture_output=True)
    record = dict(command=args, input_sha256=sha(data) if data is not None else None,
                  exit_code=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout.decode(), stderr=p.stderr.decode())
    COMMANDS.append(record)
    if expected is not None:
        assert p.returncode == expected, record
    return p.stdout.decode().strip()


def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


def blob(rev, path):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", rev+":"+path])


def norm(b):
    return b.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")


def object_id(b):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()


assert command(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"]) == PROD
base_header = command(["git", "cat-file", "-p", BASE]).split("\n\n", 1)[0]
prod_header = command(["git", "cat-file", "-p", PROD]).split("\n\n", 1)[0]
assert re.findall(r"^parent (.+)$", base_header, re.M) == ["0a35ef1fff2b7cdc15acddd9de8d5a01995418c7"]
assert re.findall(r"^parent (.+)$", prod_header, re.M) == [BASE]
command(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", "0a35ef1fff2b7cdc15acddd9de8d5a01995418c7", BASE])
command(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", BASE, PROD])
command(["git", "cat-file", "-e", "c176056a22a965b5d0411495a55a0517453fa907^{commit}"], expected=128)
remote = command(["git", "ls-remote", "origin", "refs/heads/main",
                  "refs/heads/copilot/audit-run216-227-regression-verdict-fix"])
assert remote.split() == [BASE, "refs/heads/main"]
assert object_id(blob(BASE, PLAN)) == "d44b11fe875343cae49d2823c4f02d3733283f0a"
assert sha(blob(BASE, PLAN)) == "87d6c75594571925eeac8867f7ce14f2bb0807efd47b6c70cfff0648a468315a"
audit = command(["git", "hash-object", "Audit/QBIND_SECURITY_FINDINGS_REGISTER.md"])
assert audit == "cd81efdbaf2bfb45e00dc3c60db3ea4f523adfa0"
command(["git", "-c", "core.whitespace=cr-at-eol", "diff", "--check", BASE])

old_plan = blob(BASE, PLAN)
new_plan = Path(PLAN).read_bytes()
protected = {}
for section in (8, 12, 13):
    pattern = rb"^## "+str(section).encode()+rb"\. .*?(?=^## \d+\.|\Z)"
    old = re.search(pattern, old_plan, re.M | re.S)[0]
    new = re.search(pattern, new_plan, re.M | re.S)[0]
    assert old == new
    protected[str(section)] = dict(old_sha256=sha(old), new_sha256=sha(new), equal=True)

compatibility = {}
env = json.loads((EVIDENCE/"environment.json").read_text())
assert env["producing_commit"] == PROD
assert env["producing_tree"] == command(["git", "rev-parse", PROD+"^{tree}"])
assert env["exit_code"] == 0 and env["case_count"] == 94 and env["candidate_case_count"] == 90
assert env["fixture_sha256"] == sha(Path(FIXTURE).read_bytes())
for run, path in zip((216, 227), PATHS[:2]):
    old = norm(blob(BASE, path))
    new = norm(Path(path).read_bytes())
    assert Path(path).read_bytes() == blob(PROD, path)
    assert old[old.index(b"rm -rf"):old.index(b"run_test_target()")] == new[new.index(b"rm -rf"):new.index(b"record_result()")]
    inventory = re.search(rb"^TEST_TARGETS=\(([^)]+)\)", new, re.M)[1].split()
    assert inventory == re.search(rb"^TEST_TARGETS=\(([^)]+)\)", old, re.M)[1].split()
    assert len(inventory) == (35 if run == 216 else 8)
    summary_start = f'  echo "Run {run} — release-binary'.encode()
    assert old[old.index(summary_start):old.index(b'  echo "regression test verdicts:"')] == new[new.index(summary_start):new.index(b'  echo "regression test verdicts:"')]
    limits_start = b'  echo "honest_limits:'
    assert old[old.index(limits_start):old.index(b'  echo "verdict: PASS"', old.index(limits_start))] == new[new.index(limits_start):new.index(b'  echo "aggregate:', new.index(limits_start))]
    assert b"$(run_test_target" not in new and b"$(run_lib_test" not in new
    for rev in (BASE, PROD):
        raw = blob(rev, path)
        command(["bash", "-n"], data=raw, expected=2)
        command(["bash", "-n"], data=norm(raw))
    compatibility[str(run)] = dict(required_integrations=len(inventory), required_libraries=2,
                                  inventory=[i.decode() for i in inventory],
                                  scenario_helper_denylist_prefix_identical=True,
                                  summary_scenarios_helpers_denylist_and_limits_identical=True)
    identities = env["identities"][str(run)]
    for variant, rev in (("baseline", BASE), ("candidate", PROD)):
        assert identities[variant]["matches_committed_blob"]
        assert identities[variant]["raw_sha256"] == sha(blob(rev, path))
        assert identities[variant]["normalized_sha256"] == sha(norm(blob(rev, path)))
command(["bash", "-n", FIXTURE])
ast.parse(Path(FIXTURE).read_text().split("<<'PY'\n", 1)[1].rsplit("\nPY", 1)[0])
assert Path(FIXTURE).read_bytes() == blob(PROD, FIXTURE)

cases = json.loads((EVIDENCE/"cases.json").read_text())
assert len(cases) == 94 and sum(c["attempted_count"] for c in cases) == 1694
assert all(c["cleanup_verified"] for c in cases)
raw_cases = []
for p in sorted((EVIDENCE/"raw").glob("*.jsonl")):
    raw_cases.extend(json.loads(line) for line in p.read_text().splitlines())
assert [c["case"] for c in raw_cases] == [c["case"] for c in cases]
assert len(raw_cases) == 94
for c in raw_cases:
    assert c["supervision"]["cleanup"]["remaining"] == []
    assert all(json.loads(e)["kind"] != "REJECT" for e in c["guard_log"].splitlines())
signal_cases = [c for c in raw_cases if c["mode"].startswith(("before_", "after_"))]
assert len(signal_cases) == 16
assert not any(c["supervision"].get("containment_kill") for c in signal_cases)
for c in signal_cases:
    assert c["supervision"]["alive_before_signal"]

tracked_changed = command(["git", "diff", "--name-only", BASE]).splitlines()
untracked = command(["git", "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard"]).splitlines()
changed = sorted(set(tracked_changed+untracked))
assert all(p in PATHS or p.startswith(str(EVIDENCE)+"/") for p in changed)
assert sorted(p for p in tracked_changed if not p.startswith(str(EVIDENCE)+"/")) == sorted(PATHS)
identities = []
for path in changed:
    p = Path(path)
    b = p.read_bytes()
    mode = stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)
    assert mode == 0o644, (path, mode)
    if path in PATHS[:4]:
        assert b.count(b"\n") == b.count(b"\r\n") and b"\r\n" in b and not b.endswith(b"\n")
        style = "CRLF; no terminal newline"
    else:
        assert b"\r" not in b and b.endswith(b"\n"), path
        style = "LF; terminal newline"
    if path in (str(REPORT), str(CHECKSUMS)):
        continue
    old_entry = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", BASE, "--", path]).decode().strip()
    old_mode, old_blob = ("-", "-") if not old_entry else (old_entry.split()[0], old_entry.split()[2])
    identities.append(dict(path=path, old_mode=old_mode, old_blob=old_blob,
                           new_mode="100644", new_blob=object_id(b), sha256=sha(b), bytes=len(b), eol_eof=style))

links = []
for path in [*PATHS[2:5], str(EVIDENCE/"README.md")]:
    for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)", Path(path).read_text()):
        if target.startswith(("http:", "https:", "#")):
            continue
        target = target.split("#", 1)[0]
        if not target:
            continue
        resolved = (Path(path).parent/target).resolve()
        # These two generated files are written immediately below.
        assert resolved.exists() or resolved in (REPORT.resolve(), CHECKSUMS.resolve()), (path, target)
        links.append(dict(source=path, target=target, exists_at_final_check=True))

report = dict(
    status="PASS",
    baseline=BASE, producing_commit=PROD, producing_tree=env["producing_tree"],
    entry_control_plan_blob="d44b11fe875343cae49d2823c4f02d3733283f0a",
    raw_sole_baseline_parent="0a35ef1fff2b7cdc15acddd9de8d5a01995418c7",
    raw_sole_producing_parent=BASE,
    proven_ancestry="available parent -> baseline -> implementation/test producing commit",
    unavailable_reviewed_object="c176056a22a965b5d0411495a55a0517453fa907",
    review_tree_equality_is_user_supplied_not_ancestry=True,
    audit_blob=audit, protected_sections=protected,
    source_compatibility=compatibility, case_count=94, attempted_stub_regressions=1694,
    signal_case_count=16, all_cleanup_verified=True,
    raw_crlf_syntax_exit_2_is_expected_not_execution_evidence=True,
    normalized_syntax_exit_0=True, embedded_python_ast_parse="PASS",
    allowed_tracked_paths=PATHS, changed_paths=changed,
    identity_exclusions=[str(REPORT), str(CHECKSUMS)],
    identity_exclusion_reason="No circular/self-referential hashing; both final identities are in delivery handoff",
    file_manifest=identities, local_links=links, commands=COMMANDS,
    final_commit_push_and_clean_worktree_checks="Performed after the evidence commit; recorded in delivery handoff, not self-referentially in this report",
    validation_program=Path(__file__).read_text(),
)
REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+"\n")
# Hash every changed file except this manifest itself. The report has its final bytes now.
final_paths = sorted(set(changed+[str(REPORT)]))
CHECKSUMS.write_text("".join(sha(Path(p).read_bytes())+"  "+p+"\n"
                            for p in final_paths if p != str(CHECKSUMS)))
for link in links:
    assert (Path(link["source"]).parent/link["target"]).resolve().exists(), link
size = sum(p.stat().st_size for p in EVIDENCE.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
assert size < 12*1024*1024, size
print("PASS: syntax, scope, mode/EOL/EOF, CRLF whitespace, protected sections 8/12/13, audit blob, source compatibility, identities, 94 case records, signal cleanup and relative links")
print("Evidence bytes:", size)
print("Checksums:", len(CHECKSUMS.read_text().splitlines()), "files; excludes only SHA256SUMS itself")
